in_marathi.name: Ayandeep
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Deep, Ocean of Illumination
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayandeep हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ayan means 'moving' or 'moving towards' and Deep means 'ocean' or 'deep'. So Ayandeep can be interpreted as 'moving towards the deep ocean' or 'one who is moving towards the ocean of knowledge'. It is also a name for Lord Vishnu.
